verdict.rationale: A separate sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an AI inference/training API platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no sandbox mode, test keys, or isolated non-production environment. Prototyping on serverless and a community note about a "test account" with $25 credit describe free credit and a deployment path, not isolation from production data, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
